description: This file defines the class PersonAttribute, which models key-value pairs of arbitrary person-related data within the OpenMRS system. It includes fields for attribute type, value, associated person, and methods for copying, comparison, hydration, and data management.

classes.name: PersonAttribute
classes.description: Represents a key-value pair of arbitrary information related to a person (like attributes) in the OpenMRS system. Supports copying, comparison, hydration, and voiding of attributes.

classes.name: PersonAttribute.DefaultComparator
classes.description: Comparator for PersonAttribute objects, defining an ordering based on attribute type, void status, date created, value, and id.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the PersonAttribute instance, excluding the id.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Helper method to copy properties from this instance to a target PersonAttribute, used by copy().

methods.name: equalsContent
methods.description: Compares the inner content (attributeType, value, voided status) with another PersonAttribute for equality.

methods.name: getHydratedObject
methods.description: Attempts to instantiate and hydrate an object based on the attribute type's format; defaults to returning the value string.

methods.name: voidAttribute
methods.description: Marks this attribute as voided, sets voidedBy, void reason, and date voided.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this attribute with another for ordering.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this attribute (personAttributeId).

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for this attribute.
